en: Color photograph of a large Romanesque cathedral with pale stone walls and a dark roof. The façade features a large rose window set in a darker stone panel, a simple Latin cross near the roof peak, and a series of small arches forming an arcade above the entrance level. To the right, an elaborate porch with arches and a gabled roof shelters the main doorway. Rising behind is an octagonal central tower with multiple tiers of small arched windows. The sky is clear blue and there is no visible printed caption on the front.
